title: Two circles agreed to share
body:
His summary: 'two piles, one address.' Outer 11, inner 5, center (20,20) -- ring.

His principle, ring edition: 'two circles that agreed to share. Two piles, one address.'
nine_numbers: JAH's notebook: 'a ring is two circles that agreed to share. The nine numbers draw both -- outer wall, inner hole -- and the votes pile up twice at one address. Two piles, one center: that's the whole ring.'
shape_recipe: JAH's recipe: 'vote like the circle finder, then read the table twice. Kill the phantoms -- a peak within two of a stronger radius is its echo. Two survivors, one address, different radii: ring.'
knowing_when: JAH's knowing-when: 'two piles, one address. Same center or it isn't a ring -- it's two circles that happen to be neighbors.'
